errors.what: First edit of the audit JSON by line number broke it: defect 0 already carried a fixed_by line, shifting the numbers. Reverted and re-edited by matching each defect's text.

errors.what: A combined `python3 -m http.server ... && pkill -f '[h]ttp.server'` command was refused by the hook because the unbracketed name appeared elsewhere in the line; split into two calls.

Duplicate work: PR #16276 from another quality session fixed the same high and medium defects and merged while this run's PR #16275 was open. The duplicate was found only at merge time, as a conflict. The open-PR check at the start found nothing because #16276 was opened after it. This run's version was dropped and the branch rebuilt on main with only the nuclear-safety delta.

doc_friction.issue: 'Fix forward' says to set fixed_by on each fixed defect but gives no helper; re-serialising the audit with json.dumps rewrote all 540 lines (the files use 1-space indent and a hand layout). A `quality_audit.py mark-fixed <audit> <defect-idx...> --pr <url>` would make this one safe command.

fix mode has no claim step: `queue` marks rows an open PR names, but two sessions that start minutes apart both see the row unclaimed. Opening a claim PR named for the defect right after `queue` (as sample rounds do with `quality: round N`) would have shown the second session the overlap within minutes.

deviations.why: A concurrent PR (#16276) merged the same fixes first and was more complete (it also fixed two low-severity defects), so merging main into this branch would have meant resolving two versions of one design.
deviations.did: Reset the branch to origin/main and force-pushed my own PR branch with only the missing Art 1(6) split, not a merge resolution.
deviations.result: PR #16275 carries a small, non-overlapping change

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
